plan.title: SvelteKit Params Prop Warnings Fix - Enhanced Browser Console Suppression

root_cause.description: SvelteKit automatically passes internal props (params, route, url, etc.) to page components, but Svelte warns about unknown props in the browser console during runtime
root_cause.key_insight: svelte.config.js onwarn handler only suppresses compile-time warnings, NOT runtime browser console warnings

technical_details.point: Browser console warnings are generated by Svelte's development mode runtime checks
These warnings occur when components are instantiated with undeclared props
Current svelte.config.js suppression is comprehensive but only affects compilation
Runtime warnings require browser-level console filtering

current_state.point: 25+ SvelteKit internal props identified and listed
7 regex patterns for warning detection implemented
Enhanced message-based suppression with multi-prop detection
BUT browser console still shows runtime warnings during navigation

effects.effect: Makes it harder to spot legitimate warnings and errors
Confuses developers about component prop requirements
No functional impact - purely cosmetic/DX issue

solution_approach.description: Implement both enhanced compile-time suppression AND runtime browser console filtering to eliminate all SvelteKit internal prop warnings

layer.name: Enhanced Compile-Time Suppression
layer.description: Improve existing svelte.config.js warning suppression with better pattern matching and debugging

layer.name: Comprehensive Testing
layer.description: Automated and manual testing to ensure warnings are suppressed without losing legitimate warnings
